speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned having a pruritic rash on both of your upper arms; can you describe exactly how long you have had this rash and if you have noticed any other symptoms like fever or joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient complains of a pruritic rash on both upper extremities that has been present for 5 months. She notes that the rash occasionally worsens but has not completely resolved at any point. She denies any recent illnesses and mentions that she has not started any new medications or come into contact with any new substances that she is aware of.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Notophthiriasis (scabies).
The duration of 5 months without resolution and the presence of a pruritic rash on the upper extremities in a young female are classic presentations for this condition. To confirm, I need to see the characteristic burrows, so please request images of the rash if available, or we can proceed with a skin scraping test.
